fact: The Mauritius Revenue Authority FAQ of January 2026 refers to persons registered on the Social Register of Mauritius, who continue to receive CSG income allowances at the June 2025 rates, while those not on it get lower rates.
The Mauritius Revenue Authority says the Independence Allowance of Rs 20,000 is paid to eligible youths registered on the Social Register of Mauritius on reaching 18.

The list names a 'Benefits - Local Office - Social Register of Mauritius (SRM) System' and the Social Integration Management Information System (SIMIS) of the Ministry of Social Integration, Social Security and National Solidarity among operational systems.
